WITH patient_counts AS (
  SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count
  FROM Examination
  GROUP BY ID
),
fractions AS (
  SELECT ID,
         examination_count,
         1.0 * examination_count / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS fraction
  FROM patient_counts
),
scored AS (
  SELECT ID,
         examination_count,
         fraction,
         fraction - AVG(fraction) OVER () AS excess
  FROM fractions
)
SELECT ID, examination_count, fraction, excess
FROM scored
WHERE excess > 0
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10
